svg.title: Flux: people and agents, one project
svg.desc: A short animation. The Flux logo, Kreska, draws itself next to the word flux. Jonas asks: Should we measure soil moisture first? The message becomes task #12. A decision, Measure moisture before buying sensors, is accepted. Kreska, as the agent Claude Code, picks up the task, and its result turns Positive. It ends on: People and agents, one project.
